app_identifier.description: The app the dynamic client registers under, as `appIdentifier` spells it. Required: missing and unknown answer the same `400 invalid_request` in the `oauthError` dialect. Whether that app *accepts* dynamic clients is a separate, later refusal (`access_denied`).

description: The query of `POST /oauth/register` — the one parameter RFC 7591 has no body field for.
